shellCommands.command: ls -la /workspace
cat /workspace/package.json 2>/dev/null; echo "---AGENTS---"; cat /workspace/AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null; echo "---README---"; cat /workspace/README.md 2>/dev/null
cat /workspace/opencode.json
find /workspace/app /workspace/lib -type f | sort; echo "---"; cat /workspace/next.config.ts; echo "---tsconfig---"; cat /workspace/tsconfig.json; echo "---gitignore---"; cat /workspace/.gitignore

cd /workspace && cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'; echo "---exports---"; node -e "const p=require('./node_modules/next/package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.exports, null, 2))" 2>/dev/null | head -60

cd /workspace && node -e "const p=require('./node_modules/react/package.json'); console.log('react', p.version)"; echo "---React ViewTransition export---"; node -e "const r=require('react'); console.log('ViewTransition' in r ? 'YES' : 'NO'); console.log(Object.keys(r).filter(k=>/[Vv]iew/.test(k)))"

cd /workspace && echo "=== react exports ==="; node -e "const p=require('./node_modules/react/package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.exports,null,2))"; echo "=== grep ViewTransition in react dist ==="; grep -rl "ViewTransition" node_modules/react/cjs/ node_modules/react/index.js 2>/dev/null

cd /workspace && echo "=== config schema for viewTransition ==="; grep -n "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.d.ts; echo "=== how next references addTransitionType / ViewTransition in client ==="; grep -rn "addTransitionType\|ViewTransition\|enableViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/client/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v ".map" | head -30

cd /workspace && echo "=== experimental block in config-shared (around viewTransition) ==="; grep -n "experimental" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head; echo "=== is viewTransition under experimental? ==="; sed -n '820,862p' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | grep -n "experimental\|viewTransition\|interface\|export"

cd /workspace && echo "=== @types/react version ==="; cat node_modules/@types/react/package.json | grep '"version"'; echo "=== ViewTransition in react CJS runtime? ==="; grep -rl "ViewTransition\|startViewTransition" node_modules/react/cjs/ 2>/dev/null || echo "NOT FOUND in react cjs"; echo "=== how @types/react index includes canary/experimental ==="; grep -n "canary\|experimental\|ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head; echo "=== next startViewTransition / viewTransition wiring ==="; grep -rn "startViewTransition\|experimental.viewTransition\|enableViewTransition\|view-transition" node_modules/next/dist/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v ".map:" | grep -v "node_modules/next/dist/compiled" | head -30

cd /workspace && echo "=== react/index.js ==="; cat node_modules/react/index.js; echo "=== files in react ==="; ls node_modules/react/; echo "=== grep view_transition / ViewTransition in react dev+prod (case insensitive) ==="; grep -rin "view_transition\|viewtransition" node_modules/react/cjs/*.js | head -20

cd /workspace && echo "=== react.development.js version line ==="; grep -m1 "Version" node_modules/react/cjs/react.development.js | head -1; head -5 node_modules/react/cjs/react.development.js; echo "=== does it export ViewTransition? (check exports block) ==="; grep -n "ViewTransition\|view_transition" node_modules/react/cjs/react.development.js || echo "NO ViewTransition in dev build"; echo "=== count exports ==="; grep -c "exports\." node_modules/react/cjs/react.development.js

cd /workspace && echo "=== Is there a canary/experimental react bundled by next? ==="; find node_modules -path "*react*" -name "*.js" 2>/dev/null | xargs grep -l "react.view_transition" 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== next bundled react? ==="; ls node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react* 2>/dev/null; find node_modules/next -path "*react*" -name "package.json" 2>/dev/null | head

cd /workspace && echo "=== react-experimental version ==="; grep -m1 "Version" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental/cjs/react.development.js 2>/dev/null; head -8 node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental/cjs/react.development.js 2>/dev/null; echo "=== ViewTransition export in experimental react? ==="; grep -n "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental/cjs/react.development.js 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== stable compiled react has it? ==="; grep -n "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.development.js 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== package.json versions ==="; cat node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental/package.json | grep version; cat node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/package.json | grep version

cd /workspace && echo "=== next-env.d.ts exists? ==="; ls -la next-env.d.ts .next/types 2>/dev/null || echo "no next-env.d.ts yet"; echo "=== does @types/react index export ViewTransition or reference canary? ==="; grep -n "ViewTransition\|canary\|reference types" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head; echo "=== top of @types/react/index.d.ts ==="; head -15 node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts; echo "=== experimental.d.ts top comment (opt-in instructions) ==="; head -20 node_modules/@types/react/experimental.d.ts

cd /workspace && echo "=== @types/react package.json (typesVersions/exports) ==="; node -e "const p=require('./node_modules/@types/react/package.json'); console.log('typesVersions:',JSON.stringify(p.typesVersions)); console.log('exports:',JSON.stringify(p.exports)); console.log('types:',p.types)"; echo "=== canary.d.ts reachable as react/canary? check for canary subpath ==="; ls node_modules/@types/react/*.d.ts; echo "=== how does canary.d.ts get included? top of canary.d.ts ==="; head -12 node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts

cd /workspace && echo "=== next references to react/canary or canary types generation ==="; grep -rn "react/canary\|react-canary\|next-env.d.ts" node_modules/next/dist/build/*.js node_modules/next/dist/lib/*.js 2>/dev/null | grep -iv "node_modules/next/dist/compiled" | head -20; echo "=== where next-env.d.ts content is defined ==="; grep -rln "next-env.d.ts" node_modules/next/dist/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v compiled | head
cd /workspace && sed -n '160,210p' node_modules/next/dist/lib/verify-typescript-setup.js
cd /workspace && grep -n "canary\|reference\|d\.ts\|contents\|strip-comments\|next-env" node_modules/next/dist/lib/typescript/writeAppTypeDeclarations.js | head -30

cd /workspace && echo "=== other refs to ProductGrid/ViewTransition usage ==="; grep -rn "ProductGrid\|ViewTransition\|transitionTypes" app lib --include="*.tsx" --include="*.ts" | grep -v "node_modules"
cd /workspace && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -60
cd /workspace && echo "=== next-env.d.ts ==="; cat next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "=== tsconfig include line ==="; grep -n "include\|dev/types" tsconfig.json

cd /workspace && (npx next start -p 3137 >/tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; echo "=== HOME ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3137/ ; curl -s http://localhost:3137/ | grep -o "product-card\|product-image\|

Products

" | sort -u; echo "=== PRODUCT ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3137/product/classic-sneakers ; curl -s http://localhost:3137/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o "product-hero\|product-detail\|Back to products\|Classic Sneakers" | sort -u; echo "=== server log tail ==="; tail -5 /tmp/next-start.log; pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; echo done
cd /workspace && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -25
